name: Resource-scoped inferred-sensitive S3 read (positive)
note: IAM-706 (acceptance test 7 shape): s3:ListBucket/s3:GetObject on a NAMED bucket whose name infers sensitivity (production-exports). DATA-EXFIL fires only on a BROAD resource, so this scoped read is covered by DATA-READ - a lower-certainty, neutrally-framed data-read capability with sensitivity INFERRED from naming (not proven). Must NOT fire DATA-EXFIL (not broad) or WILDCARD-RESOURCE (read verbs, named resource).
